scripts.check: npm run check:static && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:ios:collect
scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test ios/*.test.mjs ios/full/*.test.mjs ios/full/functional/coverage.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.check:python: node scripts/quality-check.mjs ruff && node --test quality/python.test.mjs && node scripts/check-python.mjs
scripts.check:static: node scripts/quality-check.mjs eslint dependencies duplicates && node --test quality/static.test.mjs
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:python
